outcome.technical: ONE RULE: a base run that is skipped, unread or still running never changes who a red is charged to, and never costs the task anything a held base would not have. Stated once as BASE_TURNS above base_turn() in drive-phase.py; red_decision_name() is the one reading of the decision a red would be asked. THE TABLE AS IT STANDS: (running-this, gate-red-writer) -> beside [decide now, the resume spends nothing]; (running-this, gate-red) -> hold [wait-base, its retry would spend an attempt over an unmeasured base]; (running-this, gate-red-base | gate-red-base-unknown) -> hold, UNREACHABLE because a running base leaves the row's own reading naming no base run and nothing unknown; (running-other, *) -> hold; (running-earlier, *) -> join [no second launch, the start takes the running launch of its commit]; (ended-pending, answered) -> refuse [answer refused, nothing spent, decision taken again]; (ended-pending, unanswered) -> retake; (ended-green, *) -> settle [mark decided, stage queued, verdict kept on the green record via _evidence_io.keep_settled_base under baseRed.settledOf, dated BASE_GREEN_NOTE when the base had the red]; (kept-unread, *) -> fall [this start's measurement decides, else gate-red-base-unknown in the refusal's words]; (own, *) -> read; any pair no row names -> hold. FINDINGS: R41 (bh0-bh3), R42 own_red asks git of the runner's path via absent_at, any git failure or a cut list measures (bo1-bo4), R43 (bh7), R44 (bh4), R45 settle_green + the note now READ: audit-lookup.py base_green_lines() matches notes by _evidence_io.BASE_GREEN_MARK, the reviewer's brief gains a 'A red its base already had' section and the sign-off's per-task section the same lines (bh5/bh6, bh5r/bh6r end to end through settle_green and the reviewer brief, bg1-bg4 in test_audit_lookup.py), R46 step_answered (kb4), R47 stamp_end/resumesAtEnd (bh8), R48 schema wording names RECORD_CUT_ORDER as the table (doc only), R49 keep_base refusing another commit (kb5). Reproduced red at HEAD 199bfe76: R41-R47 (bh0-bh8, bo1-bo4, kb4). NOT reproduced: R49 - HEAD's keep_base already refused another commit; kb5 is green at HEAD and held by mutation m10 only. MUTATIONS on a scratch copy (anchor counted, landing confirmed, restored and compared, pycache purged; logs scratchpad/p16920/mut.log and mut2.log): m1 beside for gate-red -> bh1,bh2; m2 second launch -> bh3; m3 late answer applied -> bh4; m4 declared spelling asked -> bo4; m5 git failure read as absent -> bo2; m6 kept-only failure sent to writer -> bh7; m7 green not settled -> bh5,bh6; m8 unanswered step measured -> kb4; m9 count past the end -> bh8; m10 keep_base accepts another commit -> kb5; m11 reader matches its own spelling -> bg1,bg3,bh5r; m12 writer's note drops the mark -> bg1,bg3,bh5,bh5r; m13 sign-off drops the lines -> bg3; m14 reviewer section always -> bg2,bh6r. CANCELLED BOUND / REPLACED LAUNCH vs A BASE MARK (read, no case covers it): cancelled_gate reads only GATE_LAUNCH_KEY marks; a gate relaunched after a beside resume skips base_gate (mark is beside) and never touches the base mark; a gate-cancelled decision carries no BESIDE_KEY so a base end does not drop it; after a join, launch_base's replaced (via _marked_any_start) is the joined mark carrying the same launch, so release_replaced releases the right claim; release_orphaned_launches names the joined launch and does not release it; measure-base drops the mark as before; no defect found. WALL-TIME COUNT: python3 scratchpad/p16920/reds.py <repo> 2 -> red task runs 210, writer-path tasks 1 (P131.6), free resume 0, held 210; python3 scratchpad/p16920/base_reds.py <repo> -> base runs 15, of a writer-path red 0, held 15, base durationMs sum 493795, max 161549 (one over the 120000 bound); read 07:37:10, 07:37:28, 07:45:35, identical.
